license_required.quote: Only licensees, individuals who have practice privileges under RSA 309-B:6 and RSA 310:17, and firms exempt from the permit requirement under RSA 309-B:8, may issue a report on financial statements of any other person, firm, organization, or governmental unit or otherwise offer to render or render any attest service.

umbrella_agency.value: Office of Professional Licensure and Certification
umbrella_agency.quote: The office of professional licensure and certification shall establish fees for examination of applicants, for licenses, for certificates of authorization, for reissuance of licenses, for renewal and reinstatement of licenses and certificates to practice under this chapter

moral_character_required.quote: The certificate of "certified public accountant" shall be granted to persons of good character who meet the education, experience, and examination requirements of this section

degree_required.value: At least 150 semester hours of college education including a baccalaureate or higher degree conferred by a college or university acceptable to the board
degree_required.quote: On or after July 1, 2014, at least 150 semester hours of college education including a baccalaureate or higher degree conferred by a college or university acceptable to the board, the total educational program to include an accounting concentration or equivalent as determined by board rule to be appropriate

degree_level.quote: at least 150 semester hours of college education including a baccalaureate or higher degree conferred by a college or university acceptable to the board

school_approval_basis.quote: a college or university acceptable to the board

credential_pegged.quote: at least 150 semester hours of college education including a baccalaureate or higher degree conferred by a college or university acceptable to the board, the total educational program to include an accounting concentration or equivalent as determined by board rule to be appropriate

required.quote: The experience requirement shall consist of public accounting experience in providing one or more kinds of services involving the use of accounting or auditing skills

experience_source.quote: On or after July 1, 2014, one year.

duration.quote: On or after July 1, 2014, one year.

kind.value: public accounting experience under the direction of a licensee
kind.quote: public accounting experience in providing one or more kinds of services involving the use of accounting or auditing skills, including the issuance of reports on financial statements, or one or more kinds of management advisory, financial advisory, or consulting services, or the preparation of tax returns or the furnishing of advice on tax matters, or the equivalent, all of which was under the direction of a licensee

exams.name: Uniform Certified Public Accountant Examination
exams.notes: Passing grade for each section is 75; all sections must be passed within a time period established by the board.
exams.jurisdiction: national (American Institute of Certified Public Accountants)
exams.quote: The board may make such use of all or any part of the Uniform Certified Public Accountant Examination and Advisory Grading Service of the American Institute of Certified Public Accountants

required.quote: For renewal of a certificate under this section each licensee shall participate in a program of learning designed to ensure continuing professional competence.

available.quote: All boards or commissions shall grant a license to an individual certified or licensed in another state if it determines that the requirements or standards for certification or licensure in that state are equivalent to, or greater than, those established in New Hampshire.
available.citation: [UMBRELLA / Chapter 332-G - General Administration of Regulatory Boards ] Section 332-G:12 - Reciprocity Information.

requirements.value: Substantial equivalency determination; the office shall take into account qualifications without regard to sequence in which experience, education, or examination requirements were attained.
requirements.quote: "Substantial equivalency" is a determination by the office or its designee that the education, examination, and experience requirements contained in the statutes and administrative rules of another jurisdiction are comparable to or exceed the education, examination, and experience requirements contained in the Uniform Accountancy Act

exists.quote: There is hereby created the New Hampshire board of accountancy, which shall have responsibility for the administration and enforcement of this chapter.

national_association.value: American Institute of Certified Public Accountants (AICPA) and National Association of State Boards of Accountancy (NASBA)
national_association.quote: The approach to meeting this requirement specified by the board shall be comparable to guidelines specified in the Statement on Standards for Continuing Professional Education (CPE) Programs jointly approved by the National Association of State Boards of Accountancy (NASBA) and the American Institute of Certified Public Accountants (AICPA).

regulatory_model.quote: Only licensees, individuals who have practice privileges under RSA 309-B:6 and RSA 310:17, and firms exempt from the permit requirement under RSA 309-B:8, may issue a report on financial statements of any other person, firm, organization, or governmental unit or otherwise offer to render or render any attest service.

credential_type.quote: The certificate of "certified public accountant" shall be granted to persons of good character who meet the education, experience, and examination requirements of this section

is_mandatory.quote: Only licensees, individuals who have practice privileges under RSA 309-B:6 and RSA 310:17, and firms exempt from the permit requirement under RSA 309-B:8, may issue a report on financial statements of any other person, firm, organization, or governmental unit or otherwise offer to render or render any attest service.

title_protection.quote: No person not holding a valid certificate or a practice privilege under RSA 309-B:6 and RSA 310:17 shall use or assume the title or designation "certified public accountant," or the abbreviation "CPA" or any other title, designation, words, letters, abbreviation, sign, card, or device tending to indicate that such person is a certified public accountant.

scope_protection.quote: Only licensees, individuals who have practice privileges under RSA 309-B:6 and RSA 310:17, and firms exempt from the permit requirement under RSA 309-B:8, may issue a report on financial statements of any other person, firm, organization, or governmental unit or otherwise offer to render or render any attest service.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Fraud or deceit in obtaining a certificate, permit, or registration.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Fraud or deceit in obtaining a certificate, permit, or registration.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Cancellation, revocation, suspension, or refusal to renew a license or practice rights by any other state for disciplinary reasons.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Cancellation, revocation, suspension, or refusal to renew a license or practice rights by any other state, including possessions of the United States, for any cause involving disciplinary reasons.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to maintain compliance with requirements for issuance or renewal of certificate, permit, or registration, or to report changes as required.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure, on the part of a holder of a certificate under RSA 309-B:7 or permit under RSA 309-B:8 or registration under RSA 309-B:9, to maintain compliance with the requirements for issuance or renewal of such certificate, permit, or registration or to report changes as required under RSA 309-B:7 and 309-B:8, VI.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Revocation or suspension of the right to practice before any state or federal agency for disciplinary reasons.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Revocation or suspension of the right to practice before any state, including possessions of the United States, or federal agency for disciplinary reasons.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Dishonesty, fraud, or gross negligence in the performance of services or in filing/failing to file tax returns.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Dishonesty, fraud, or gross negligence in the performance of services as a licensee or in the filing or failure to file the licensee's own income or employment tax returns or the payment of the licensee's income or employment tax liability.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of any provision of this chapter, board rules, or professional standards.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violation of any provision of this chapter or rule adopted by the board under this chapter or violation of professional standards.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of any rule of professional conduct adopted by the board.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violation of any rule of professional conduct adopted by the board under RSA 309-B:4, VIII(d).

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of a felony or any crime involving dishonesty or fraud.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Conviction of a felony, or of any crime an element of which is dishonesty or fraud, under the laws of the United States, of this state, or of any other state, of any possessions of the United States, or of any other country if the acts involved would have constituted a crime under the laws of this state.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Performance of any fraudulent act while holding a certificate, registration, or permit.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Performance of any fraudulent act while holding a certificate, registration, or permit issued under this chapter or prior law.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Any conduct reflecting adversely upon the licensee's fitness to perform services.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Any conduct reflecting adversely upon the licensee's fitness to perform services as a licensee.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Making any false or misleading statement or verification in support of another's application.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Making any false or misleading statement or verification, in support of an application for a certificate, registration, or permit filed by another.

establishment_regulation_required.quote: Any firm with an office in this state performing attest services as defined in RSA 309-B:3, I, or compilation services under RSA 309-B:3, III-a

definition_quote.value: "Attest" means providing the following services: Any audit or other engagement to be performed in accordance with the American Institute of Certified Public Accountants' Statements on Auditing Standards (SAS); Any review of a financial statement to be performed in accordance with the American Institute of Certified Public Accountants' Statements on Standards for Accounting and Review Services (SSARS); Any examination of prospective financial statements to be performed in accordance with the American Institute of Certified Public Accountants' Statements on Standards for Attestation Engagements (SSAE); Any engagement to be performed in accordance with the Public Company Accounting Oversight Board's Auditing Standards; Any examination, review, or agreed upon procedures engagement to be performed in accordance with the Statements on Standards for Attestation Engagements (SSAE).
definition_quote.quote: "Attest" means providing the following services: (1) Any audit or other engagement to be performed in accordance with the American Institute of Certified Public Accountants' Statements on Auditing Standards (SAS).

methods_authorized.quote: Any audit or other engagement to be performed in accordance with the American Institute of Certified Public Accountants' Statements on Auditing Standards (SAS).

value: audit or other engagement per AICPA Statements on Auditing Standards (SAS)
review of financial statement per AICPA Statements on Standards for Accounting and Review Services (SSARS)
examination of prospective financial statements per AICPA Statements on Standards for Attestation Engagements (SSAE)
examination, review, or agreed upon procedures per SSAE
attest_services_types.quote: "Attest" means providing the following services: (1) Any audit or other engagement to be performed in accordance with the American Institute of Certified Public Accountants' Statements on Auditing Standards (SAS). (2) Any review of a financial statement to be performed in accordance with the American Institute of Certified Public Accountants' Statements on Standards for Accounting and Review Services (SSARS). (3) Any examination of prospective financial statements to be performed in accordance with the American Institute of Certified Public Accountants' Statements on Standards for Attestation Engagements (SSAE). (4) Any engagement to be performed in accordance with the Public Company Accounting Oversight Board's Auditing Standards. (5) Any examination, review, or agreed upon procedures engagement to be performed in accordance with the Statements on Standards for Attestation Engagements (SSAE)

compilation_services_authorized.quote: "Compilation" means providing a service to be performed in accordance with the American Institute of Certified Public Accountants' Statements on Standards for Accounting and Review Services (SSARS) that is presenting in the form of financial statements, information that is the representation of management without undertaking to express any assurance on the statements.

education_semester_hours_required.quote: On or after July 1, 2014, at least 150 semester hours of college education including a baccalaureate or higher degree conferred by a college or university acceptable to the board

exam_sit_hours_minimum.quote: candidates for a certificate may sit for the examination described in paragraph IV if they have at least 120 semester hours of college education including a baccalaureate degree conferred by a college or university acceptable to the board

attest_services_require_firm_permit.quote: The holder of a certificate issued under this section may provide attest services as defined in RSA 309-B:3, I(a), and compilation services as defined in RSA 309-B:3, III-a, only in a CPA firm that holds a permit issued under RSA 309-B:8.

firm_majority_cpa_ownership_required.quote: at least a simple majority of the ownership of the firm, in terms of financial interests and voting rights of all partners, officers, shareholders, members or managers, belongs to holders of a certificate who are licensed in some state of the United States

nonlicensee_firm_owners_permitted.quote: Firms may include non-licensee owners but the firm and its ownership shall comply with rules adopted by the board.

peer_review_required_for_firm_renewal.quote: The board shall by rule require, on either a uniform or random basis, as a condition to renewal of permits under this section, that applicants undergo, no more frequently than once every 3 years, peer reviews conducted in such manner as the board shall specify

peer_review_max_frequency_years.quote: no more frequently than once every 3 years, peer reviews conducted in such manner as the board shall specify

peer_review_records_privileged.quote: the peer review processes be operated, and documents maintained in a manner designed to preserve confidentiality, and that neither the board nor any third party, other than the peer review oversight body, shall have access to documents furnished or generated in the course of such peer review.

inactive_license_status_available.quote: The board may by rule create an exception to this requirement for licensees who do not perform or offer to perform for the public one or more kinds of services involving the use of accounting or auditing skills

retired_license_status_available.quote: The office of professional licensure and certification shall grant retired status to a person who meets the following criteria

out_of_state_firm_no_office_exemption.quote: it shall not be a violation of this section for a firm which does not hold a valid permit under RSA 309-B:8 and which does not have an office in this state to provide its professional services in this state if it complies with the requirements of RSA 309-B:8, I(a)(3) or I(b), whichever is applicable.

attest_report_signer_competency_requirem.quote: Any individual licensee and any individual qualifying for practice privileges under RSA 309-B:6 and RSA 310:17 who is responsible for supervising attest services, and signs or authorizes someone to sign the accountant's report on behalf of the firm, shall meet the appropriate experience requirements for such services as required by professional standards for such services.

client_confidentiality_privilege.quote: a licensee or any partner, officer, member, manager, shareholder, or employee of a licensee shall not voluntarily disclose information communicated to such person by the client relating to and in connection with services rendered to the client by the licensee. Such information shall be deemed confidential

working_papers_ownership_by_licensee.quote: all statements, records, schedules, working papers, and memoranda made by a licensee or a partner, shareholder, officer, director, member, manager, or employee of a licensee, incident to, or in the course of, rendering services to a client except for the records that are part of the client's records, shall be and remain the property of the licensee in the absence of an express agreement between the licensee and the client to the contrary.

commission_prohibition_during_attest.quote: A licensee, individual qualifying for a practice privilege under RSA 309-B:6 and RSA 310:17, or firm exempt from the permit requirement under RSA 309-B:8, shall not for a commission recommend or refer to a client any product or service, or for a commission recommend or refer any product or service to be supplied by a client, or receive a commission, when the licensee, individual qualifying for a practice privilege under RSA 309-B:6 and RSA 310:17, or firm exempt from the permit requirement under RSA 309-B:8, also performs for that client an attest service

contingent_fee_prohibition_during_attest.quote: A licensee, individual qualifying for a practice privilege under RSA 309-B:6 and RSA 310:17, or firm exempt from the permit requirement under RSA 309-B:8, shall not: (1) Perform for a contingent fee any professional services for, or receive such a fee from a client for whom the licensee...performs an attest service

safe_harbor_disclaimer_language_for_nonl.quote: the board shall issue safe harbor language that persons not licensed under this chapter, or not qualifying for a practice privilege under RSA 309-B:6 and RSA 310:17, or not exempt from the permit requirement under RSA 309-B:8 may use in connection with such financial information.

foreign_accountant_practice_exception.quote: No provision of this section shall have any application to a person holding a certification, designation, degree, license, or permit granted in a foreign country entitling the holder to engage in the practice of public accountancy or its equivalent in such country, whose activities in this state are limited to the provision of professional services to persons or firms who are residents of, governments of, or business entities of the country in which the person holds such entitlement

firm_corrective_action_period_for_owners.quote: Firms which fall out of compliance with the provisions of this section due to changes in firm ownership or personnel, after receiving or renewing a license, shall take corrective action to bring the firm back into compliance as quickly as possible. The board may grant a reasonable period of time for a firm to take such corrective action.

firm_permit_required_for_attest_services.quote: Any firm with an office in this state performing attest services as defined in RSA 309-B:3, I, or compilation services under RSA 309-B:3, III-a

accounting_practitioner_tier.quote: Persons who on January 1, 2000 hold registrations as public accountants issued under prior law of this state shall be entitled to have their registrations renewed upon fulfillment of the continuing professional education requirements

cpa_emeritus_or_retired_status_available.quote: The office of professional licensure and certification shall grant retired status to a person who meets the following criteria

client_records_return_obligation.quote: A licensee shall furnish to the client or former client, upon request and reasonable notice: (a) A copy of the licensee's working papers, to the extent that such working papers include records that would ordinarily constitute part of the client's records and are not otherwise available to the client; and (b) Any accounting or other records belonging to, or obtained from or on behalf of, the client
